description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeObject' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule'. The class sets up a module for handling 'SafeObject', a sanitized object embedding mechanism in HTML, specifically allowing safe embedding of Flash objects and related parameters within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeObject
classes.description: A module for integrating safe object embedding (e.g., Flash objects) into HTML content within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by defining 'object' and 'param' elements with specific attributes and attribute transformations, ensuring safe embedding of objects like Flash files.
